svg.title: last_entity_event while jobs are expanded
svg.desc: Six events are added in order. For each, the table shows the map lookup (rule A), the leaf edges (rule B), the bay edge (rule C) and the map afterwards; the DAG on the right colours each edge by the rule that added it.

g.text: Same six events as the topological-ordering figure. Keys are GarageEntityIdMsg values built with AgvId / TrayId / BayId / VecsId; a TrayMove with no tray has no key and skips rule A.

g.text: The map holds, for each AGV, tray, bay and VECS, the last event that touched it. UpdateLastEntityEvent(key, e) adds last[key] -> e if there is an entry, then sets last[key] =
